tasks.task_name: Define CodedocConfig struct and codedoc domain types
tasks.goal: CodedocConfig is parseable from YAML with all fields from Section 12 (max_rounds, min_rounds, max_cost_usd, max_wall_clock_minutes, max_retries, max_gate_corrections, max_gate_draft_redrafts, staleness_threshold, agent_timeout_seconds, discovery_timeout_seconds, reviewer_timeout_seconds, enable_codex_codedoc_discovery, enable_codex_codedoc_drafting, enable_codex_reviewers, codex_model, default_mode, backup_before_write, docs_output_dir, drift_warning_threshold, write_lock_timeout_seconds), defaults are applied, validation rejects invalid values per Section 12, and all codedoc domain types (DiscoveryOutput, DrafterOutput, CodeAuditFinding, SanitisationReport, ManifestFile, severity constants) are defined with JSON tags.

outputs.name: config_struct
outputs.constraints: all numeric fields validated per Section 12 rules, min_rounds <= max_rounds, thresholds in range

outputs.name: domain_types
outputs.constraints: DiscoveryOutput, DrafterOutput, CodeAuditFinding, AuditSummary, SanitisationReport, ManifestFile, severity constants defined

acceptance: DefaultCodedocConfig() returns max_rounds=3, min_rounds=1, max_cost_usd=50.0, max_wall_clock_minutes=90, max_retries=2, max_gate_corrections=3, max_gate_draft_redrafts=2, staleness_threshold=2, agent_timeout_seconds=600, discovery_timeout_seconds=1200, reviewer_timeout_seconds=300, default_mode=full, backup_before_write=true, docs_output_dir=docs, drift_warning_threshold=0.20, write_lock_timeout_seconds=300
Parsing YAML with max_rounds: 5 produces MaxRounds=5
ValidateConfig returns error for max_rounds=0 containing 'must be >= 1'
ValidateConfig returns error for min_rounds > max_rounds containing 'must be <= max_rounds'
ValidateConfig returns error for drift_warning_threshold=1.5 containing 'must be >= 0.0 and <= 1.0'
ValidateConfig returns error for agent_timeout_seconds=0 containing 'must be > 0'
SeverityCritical, SeverityMajor, SeverityMinor, SeverityObservation constants equal 'critical', 'major', 'minor', 'observation'
CodeAuditFinding struct has fields ID, Type, Severity, FilePath, LineNumber, Symbol, Description, Evidence with json tags
ManifestFile struct has fields SchemaVersion, WorkflowFeature, GeneratedAt, Modules, FilesDocumented with json tags
go test ./internal/codedoc/ -run TestConfig passes
go test ./internal/codedoc/ -run TestTypes passes

depends_on.reason: First task, new package with no dependencies on other new code

constraints: New package internal/codedoc separate from specworkflow and codereview
Use yaml struct tags consistent with existing config patterns in config.yaml

tasks.task_name: Define JSON output schemas for discovery, drafter, reviewer, and judge agents
tasks.goal: Go structs and JSON schema definitions exist for the discovery output (Section 9), drafter output (Section 10), reviewer output (Section 11), and judge output, each with validation functions that check required fields and enum values.

outputs.name: schema_structs
outputs.constraints: structs match JSON schemas from spec Sections 9-11 exactly

acceptance: DiscoveryOutput struct marshals to JSON matching Section 9 schema with all fields (schema_version, agent, mode, completion_status, tools_used, languages, frameworks, modules, entry_points, dependency_graph, existing_docs, test_coverage_overview, suggested_scope, incremental_changes, merge_log)
DrafterOutput struct marshals to JSON matching Section 10 schema with all fields (as_implemented_report, architecture_diagrams, code_audit, doc_updates, structural_summary)
ReviewerOutput struct marshals to JSON matching Section 11 schema with findings array containing id, description, severity, status, impact, recommendation, lens, affected_section, affected_file
ValidateDiscoveryOutput returns error for missing schema_version field
ValidateDiscoveryOutput returns error for invalid completion_status.status value
ValidateDrafterOutput returns error for missing as_implemented_report
ValidateReviewerOutput returns error for finding with empty severity
go test ./internal/codedoc/ -run TestSchemas passes
constraints: Struct field types must match the JSON schemas exactly
Reuse severity constants from types.go

tasks.task_name: Implement codedoc state machine with transitions and guards
tasks.goal: A StateMachine instance for codedoc enforces the transition table from Section 2 (CD_INIT through CD_COMPLETE/CD_ESCALATED/CD_ERROR) with MaxRoundsGuard, CostGuard, WallClockGuard, and StalenessGuard blocking transitions when limits are exceeded, and universal CD_ERROR transitions from any non-terminal state.

outputs.name: state_machine
outputs.constraints: all CD_ states defined, transition table from Section 2 enforced, guards implemented

acceptance: States CD_INIT, CD_DISCOVERY, CD_HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE, CD_DRAFTING, CD_SANITISING, CD_HUMAN_GATE_DRAFT, CD_REVIEWING, CD_REVISING, CD_JUDGING, CD_HUMAN_GATE_FINAL, CD_WRITING, CD_COMPLETE, CD_ESCALATED, CD_ERROR are defined as string constants
Transition CD_INIT -> CD_DISCOVERY succeeds
Transition CD_DISCOVERY -> CD_HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE succeeds
Transition CD_HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE -> CD_DRAFTING succeeds
Transition CD_HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE -> CD_DISCOVERY succeeds (scope re-run)
Transition CD_SANITISING -> CD_DRAFTING succeeds (unredacted secrets)
Transition CD_JUDGING -> CD_REVIEWING succeeds (REVISE verdict)
Transition CD_JUDGING -> CD_WRITING succeeds (PASS verdict)
Transition CD_JUDGING -> CD_HUMAN_GATE_FINAL succeeds (unresolved CRIT/MAJOR)
Transition CD_INIT -> CD_COMPLETE returns error containing 'invalid transition'
Transition CD_ERROR -> CD_ERROR returns error (blocked)
Any non-terminal state -> CD_ERROR succeeds
MaxRoundsGuard blocks CD_REVIEWING when round > max_rounds
CostGuard blocks when cumulative cost > max_cost_usd
WallClockGuard blocks when elapsed > max_wall_clock_minutes
go test ./internal/codedoc/ -run TestStateMachine passes
constraints: Replicate StateMachine pattern from specworkflow/statemachine.go but with codedoc states and transitions

tasks.task_name: Implement discovery phase with dual-provider support and merge agent
tasks.goal: The discovery phase analyses a codebase path, produces a DiscoveryOutput conforming to Section 9 schema, supports dual-provider execution (Claude + Codex in parallel) with LLM-based merge agent per Section 3a, falls back to Claude-only on Codex or merge failure, and reports completion_status as complete or partial with reason.

inputs.name: code_path
inputs.constraints: valid filesystem path to a directory

acceptance: Single-provider discovery produces a valid DiscoveryOutput with modules, entry_points, dependency_graph, existing_docs, languages, and suggested_scope populated
When enable_codex_codedoc_discovery=true and Codex available, both providers run concurrently and the merge agent produces a merged output with merge_log
When Codex fails but Claude succeeds, the workflow continues with Claude-only output and logs a warning
When both providers fail, the function returns an error that causes escalation
When merge agent fails, Claude-only output is used with a warning logged
Discovery respects discovery_timeout_seconds and reports completion_status=partial with reason when timed out
Per-provider outputs are saved as discovery-output-claude-v{N}.json and discovery-output-codex-v{N}.json
Merged output is saved as discovery-output-merged-v{N}.json
go test ./internal/codedoc/ -run TestDiscovery passes
constraints: Reuse AgentRunner interface from specworkflow/claude_runner.go
Follow the dual-dispatch pattern from specworkflow/orchestrator_discovery.go

tasks.task_name: Implement drafting phase with dual-provider combine agent
tasks.goal: The drafting phase produces all documentation artefacts (as-implemented report, Mermaid architecture diagrams, code audit JSON and report, doc update list) conforming to Section 10 schema, supports dual-provider execution with LLM-based combine agent per Section 3b, validates Mermaid syntax after generation and after combine, and falls back to Claude-only on failure.

inputs.name: scope_corrections
inputs.constraints: may be nil if no corrections

outputs.name: drafter_output
outputs.constraints: conforms to Section 10 schema, all mermaid_valid fields accurate

acceptance: Single-provider drafting produces a valid DrafterOutput with as_implemented_report, architecture_diagrams (at least 3: module-dependencies, call-flows, data-flows), code_audit, and doc_updates
When enable_codex_codedoc_drafting=true and Codex available, both providers run concurrently and the combine agent merges outputs
Mermaid syntax is validated on each diagram; mermaid_valid field reflects actual validation result
When dual-provider combine produces an invalid Mermaid diagram, it is replaced with the base provider's diagram
When Codex or combine agent fails, Claude-only output is used with a warning
Draft artefact files are written to workspace/codedoc/{feature}/draft-v{N}/ directory
structural_summary fields (report_sections, diagram_count, audit_finding_count, doc_updates, modules_documented) are accurate counts
go test ./internal/codedoc/ -run TestDrafting passes
constraints: Follow dual-dispatch pattern from specworkflow
Mermaid validation must not execute arbitrary code

tasks.task_name: Implement secret sanitisation scanner for documentation output
tasks.goal: The sanitisation phase scans all documentation output files for secret patterns (API keys, tokens, connection strings, passwords, private keys, PII) per Section 3d, redacts detected secrets with [REDACTED: category] placeholders, produces a sanitisation report, and transitions back to drafting when un-redactable secrets are found.

inputs.name: draft_files
inputs.constraints: markdown, JSON, and Mermaid files from drafting phase

outputs.name: sanitised_files
outputs.constraints: same files with secrets replaced by [REDACTED: category]

outputs.name: sanitisation_report
outputs.constraints: lists each redaction with file_path, line_number, pattern_category

acceptance: Detects AKIA prefix API keys and redacts to [REDACTED: api_key]
Detects sk- prefix keys and redacts to [REDACTED: api_key]
Detects ghp_ and glpat- prefix tokens and redacts to [REDACTED: token]
Detects postgres://, mongodb://, redis://, mysql:// connection strings with credentials and redacts to [REDACTED: connection_string]
Detects password= and secret: key-value patterns and redacts to [REDACTED: password]
Detects PEM private key headers and redacts to [REDACTED: private_key]
Detects JWT strings (eyJ prefix) and redacts to [REDACTED: token]
Returns needs_redraft=true when secrets are woven into prose and cannot be safely redacted
Sanitisation report contains accurate file_path, line_number, and pattern_category for each redaction
When no secrets are detected, report has empty redactions array and needs_redraft=false
go test ./internal/codedoc/ -run TestSanitisation passes
constraints: Regex-based detection per Section 3d patterns
Must not modify files outside the draft directory

tasks.task_name: Implement review dispatch with 4 groups and 9 lenses for codedoc
tasks.goal: The review dispatch sends documentation to 4 parallel reviewer groups (Accuracy: ACC+CUR, Completeness: CMP+CLA, Architecture: ARC+STR, Audit+Security: AUD+CON+SEC) using the same parallel dispatch and failure tolerance pattern as specworkflow/review_dispatch.go, merges findings with codedoc-specific dedup key, and supports dual-provider reviewers.

outputs.name: merged_findings
outputs.constraints: deduplicated, each with severity, status, lens code

acceptance: 4 reviewer groups are dispatched in parallel
Group 1 applies ACC and CUR lenses, Group 2 applies CMP and CLA lenses, Group 3 applies ARC and STR lenses, Group 4 applies AUD, CON, and SEC lenses
When one reviewer group fails, other groups still complete and findings are merged from successful groups
Findings are deduplicated by (lens, affected_file, affected_section) tuple
When enable_codex_reviewers=true, Codex reviewers run in parallel with Claude reviewers and findings are merged
Each finding has severity classified per the rubric: CRITICAL, MAJOR, MINOR, OBSERVATION
Each finding has status=open when newly created
ARC findings on diagrams include corrected Mermaid snippet in recommendation field
Per-group outputs are saved to review-{a,b,c,d}-round-{N}.json
go test ./internal/codedoc/ -run TestReviewDispatch passes
constraints: Adapt review_dispatch.go pattern from specworkflow
Use same MergeReviewerOutputs function pattern with codedoc-specific DedupKeyFunc

tasks.task_name: Implement convergence evaluation and judge agent for codedoc
tasks.goal: The judge evaluates review findings and renders a verdict: PASS (route to CD_WRITING when no unresolved CRITICAL/MAJOR), PASS_WITH_GATE (route to CD_HUMAN_GATE_FINAL when unresolved CRITICAL/MAJOR remain), or REVISE (route to CD_REVIEWING), with staleness detection halting after consecutive stale rounds.
acceptance: Zero open findings returns PASS verdict and CD_WRITING next state
All findings resolved or MINOR/OBSERVATION returns PASS verdict and CD_WRITING next state
Open CRITICAL findings return PASS_WITH_GATE verdict and CD_HUMAN_GATE_FINAL next state when min_rounds met
Open MAJOR findings return PASS_WITH_GATE verdict and CD_HUMAN_GATE_FINAL next state when min_rounds met
Open CRITICAL or MAJOR findings before min_rounds return REVISE verdict and CD_REVIEWING next state
DetectStaleness returns true after staleness_threshold consecutive rounds without CRIT+MAJ decrease
When staleness detected, verdict is PASS_WITH_GATE to escalate to human
Judge output JSON includes verdict, reasoning, and per-severity finding counts
go test ./internal/codedoc/ -run TestConvergence passes
constraints: Adapt convergence pattern from codereview/convergence.go
Severity-based verdict following Section 3 rubric

tasks.task_name: Implement revision agent that addresses review findings
tasks.goal: The revision agent receives open review findings and the current draft documentation, produces updated documentation that addresses CRITICAL and MAJOR findings, marks addressed findings as resolved, and outputs a revision report.

outputs.name: revision_output
outputs.constraints: list of addressed findings with updated status

acceptance: CRITICAL findings are addressed first, then MAJOR findings
Each addressed finding has status changed from open to resolved in the revision output
Findings marked wontfix include a rationale string
Revised documentation files are written to a new draft version directory
Mermaid diagrams in revised docs are re-validated after revision
The revision output includes a count of addressed, wontfix, and remaining open findings
go test ./internal/codedoc/ -run TestRevision passes
constraints: Use AgentRunner interface for LLM invocation
Must not introduce new issues while fixing existing ones

tasks.task_name: Implement writing phase with staging directory, atomic move, backup, and lock
tasks.goal: The writing phase writes approved documentation to the target repo's docs/ directory using the staging-then-move pattern from Section 3c, creates timestamped backups before overwriting, acquires an exclusive docs/ write lock with stale lock detection, detects codebase drift by comparing file hashes against discovery output, and preserves manual marker sections in existing files.

outputs.name: written_files
outputs.constraints: paths of files written to docs/

acceptance: Files are first written to docs/.codedoc-staging/ before being moved to final location
All expected files in staging are validated as present and non-empty before move
For each file that would be overwritten, a backup is created at {filename}.bak.{YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS}
Files are moved from staging to final location using os.Rename
Staging directory is removed after successful write
Lock file docs/.codedoc-write.lock is created with workflow feature name and PID
When lock is held by another live process, writing retries with exponential backoff up to write_lock_timeout_seconds
When lock file exists but PID is dead, stale lock is broken and re-acquired
Lock is released on success and on error
Drift detection compares current file hashes against discovery output content_hash fields
When drift exceeds drift_warning_threshold, a drift warning is returned
Manual marker sections (<!-- manual --> / <!-- /manual -->) in existing files are preserved at structural positions
When a section containing a manual block is removed, the block is appended to end with warning comment
.codedoc-manifest.json is written atomically (write to .tmp then os.Rename)
go test ./internal/codedoc/ -run TestWriting passes
constraints: Must not modify source code files
Must not write files outside docs/ directory
Lock must be released in all code paths including panics

tasks.task_name: Implement three human gate handlers for scope, draft, and final approval
tasks.goal: Three human gate states (CD_HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE, CD_HUMAN_GATE_DRAFT, CD_HUMAN_GATE_FINAL) pause the workflow, present relevant payloads to the user via API, and process approve/correct/cancel decisions with the correct state transitions and correction limits.

inputs.name: gate_payload
inputs.constraints: content varies by gate type per US-7

acceptance: SCOPE gate displays: module inventory, completion status, dependency overview, existing doc inventory, suggested scope, and merge conflicts from dual-provider
SCOPE gate accept advances to CD_DRAFTING
SCOPE gate correct stores scope adjustments and re-enters CD_DISCOVERY up to max_gate_corrections times
SCOPE gate cancel transitions to CD_ESCALATED
DRAFT gate displays: generated file list, summary statistics, redaction log from sanitisation
DRAFT gate accept advances to CD_REVIEWING
DRAFT gate re-draft passes user comment to drafter and re-enters CD_DRAFTING up to max_gate_draft_redrafts times
DRAFT gate forces approve-or-cancel after max_gate_draft_redrafts exhausted
FINAL gate displays remaining unresolved CRITICAL/MAJOR findings
FINAL gate accept advances to CD_WRITING
FINAL gate reject transitions to CD_ESCALATED
FINAL gate request-review re-enters CD_REVIEWING
go test ./internal/codedoc/ -run TestGates passes
constraints: Follow gate handler pattern from specworkflow/orchestrator.go
Gate corrections are versioned in workspace

tasks.task_name: Implement main orchestrator that drives the full codedoc workflow lifecycle
tasks.goal: The CodedocOrchestrator drives the workflow through all states (CD_INIT to CD_COMPLETE), coordinates discovery, drafting, sanitisation, review loop, revision, judging, and writing phases, persists workflow state for crash recovery, supports resume from CD_ERROR via artefact detection per Section 2, and emits WebSocket events for dashboard updates.
acceptance: Full workflow (single-provider) progresses through CD_INIT -> CD_DISCOVERY -> CD_HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE -> CD_DRAFTING -> CD_SANITISING -> CD_HUMAN_GATE_DRAFT -> CD_REVIEWING -> CD_REVISING -> CD_JUDGING -> CD_WRITING -> CD_COMPLETE
Workflow state is persisted to workflow-state.json after each state transition
Resume from CD_ERROR with no discovery output restarts at CD_DISCOVERY
Resume from CD_ERROR with discovery output but no drafter output restarts at CD_HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE
Resume from CD_ERROR with drafter output but no review outputs restarts at CD_HUMAN_GATE_DRAFT
Resume from CD_ERROR with review outputs restarts at CD_REVIEWING
Resume from CD_ERROR with staging directory restarts at CD_HUMAN_GATE_FINAL
Circuit breaker fires CD_ESCALATED when cost exceeds max_cost_usd
Circuit breaker fires CD_ESCALATED when time exceeds max_wall_clock_minutes
Circuit breaker fires CD_ESCALATED when rounds exceed max_rounds
WebSocket events are emitted for each state transition
go test ./internal/codedoc/ -run TestOrchestrator passes
constraints: Follow orchestrator pattern from specworkflow/orchestrator.go
Structured logging to workflow-log.jsonl

tasks.task_name: Implement API handlers for codedoc workflow endpoints
tasks.goal: HTTP handlers exist for all 7 codedoc API endpoints from Section 13 (start, status, gate, cancel, resume, reset, rewind), registered on the server router, accepting and returning JSON per the specified contracts.
acceptance: POST /api/codedoc/start with valid body (feature_name, code_path, mode) returns 202 and starts workflow
POST /api/codedoc/start with missing code_path returns 400 with error message
GET /api/codedoc/{feature}/status returns 200 with current workflow state
GET /api/codedoc/{feature}/status for non-existent feature returns 404
POST /api/codedoc/{feature}/gate with approve decision returns 200 and advances workflow
POST /api/codedoc/{feature}/cancel returns 200 and transitions to CD_ESCALATED
POST /api/codedoc/{feature}/resume returns 200 and resumes from CD_ERROR
POST /api/codedoc/{feature}/resume when not in CD_ERROR returns 409 with error
POST /api/codedoc/{feature}/reset returns 200 and deletes feature workspace
POST /api/codedoc/{feature}/rewind with target state returns 200
go test ./internal/api/ -run TestCodedocHandlers passes
constraints: Register on existing server router alongside spec and codereview endpoints
Follow handler patterns from internal/api/workflow_handler.go

tasks.task_name: Implement incremental mode with manifest-based delta computation
tasks.goal: When mode=incremental and a valid .codedoc-manifest.json exists, discovery compares current codebase state against manifest hashes to identify added, modified, and removed modules, drafting regenerates only changed module documentation, and architecture diagrams are fully regenerated when the dependency graph changes.
acceptance: When .codedoc-manifest.json exists and is valid, incremental discovery produces incremental_changes with lists of added, modified, and removed modules
When .codedoc-manifest.json does not exist, incremental mode falls back to full mode with a logged warning
When .codedoc-manifest.json is unparseable, incremental mode falls back to full mode with a logged warning containing the parse error
When fewer than 20% of modules changed, recommendation is 'incremental'
When 20% or more modules changed, recommendation is 'full'
Incremental drafting only regenerates documentation for changed modules
Architecture diagrams are regenerated in full when any dependency graph edge changes
Updated manifest is written with only changed module entries updated
go test ./internal/codedoc/ -run TestIncremental passes
constraints: Must handle corrupt manifests gracefully
Hash comparison uses SHA-256

tasks.task_name: Add codedoc workflow to dashboard with pipeline stages and CD badge

CD badge is visually distinct from SPEC and CR badges
Pipeline visualisation shows all 12 stages from Section 14 (Init, Discover, Scope, Draft, Sanitise, Review Draft, Review, Revise, Judge, Final, Write, Done)
Current state is highlighted in the pipeline visualisation
Gate states show approve/correct/cancel buttons appropriate to each gate type
SCOPE gate displays module inventory, completion status, and merge conflicts
DRAFT gate displays file list, summary statistics, and redaction log
FINAL gate displays remaining unresolved findings
WebSocket events for codedoc workflows update the dashboard in real time

Must not break existing SPEC and CR workflow display

tasks.task_name: Write all LLM prompts for codedoc agents
tasks.goal: Prompt templates exist for all codedoc agents: discovery (single + merge), drafting (single + combine), sanitisation, review (4 groups with 9 lenses), revision, and judge, each with structured JSON output instructions and the severity classification rubric from Section 3.

outputs.constraints: string constants or template functions for each agent prompt

Discovery merge prompt encodes all 7 merge rules from Section 3a

Invalid codedoc config values cause server startup to fail with descriptive error
